add_search_tool_to_db: add a new search tool with name, litellm params, and info to the database
delete_search_tool_from_db: delete a search tool from the database by its ID
update_search_tool_in_db: update an existing search tool identified by its ID in the database
get_all_search_tools_from_db: get all search tools from the database ordered by creation date
get_search_tool_by_id_from_db: retrieve a single search tool from the database by its ID
